# Architecture decision template

Record choices that are costly to reverse. Keep the decision proportional to its scope.

## Context

State the requirement, observed bottleneck, or constraint.

## Options and evidence

Compare the existing approach with credible alternatives. Include relevant maintenance, license, security, cost, and operational implications.

## Decision and consequences

State the choice, why it meets the requirement, and the tradeoffs accepted. Link any measurements; label assumptions.

## Revisit condition

Specify what evidence or changed requirement would justify reopening the decision.
